beats.reason: Brief explicitly earlier-week cape from arrival blanket and James independence/support exchange; source origin Pilot.
Brief practical cooperation/training arrangement after altered rescue aftermath; actual tests occur in Episode 2.
DEO missile tests and Winn harbor alert; Kara shares destination with Alex.
Breath worsens fire and hull starts dimpling; ordinary backup call brings Adrian, crew-directed towing prevents original cargo spill. Rescue exposes him publicly.
Maxwell criticism targets actual fire/control risk, not nonexistent spill; Cat recognizes Adrian but still demands Supergirl’s own interview.
Plastino guard killed/stinger evidence, Kara childhood Alura memory and species identification.
Alex discloses emitters and obtains agreement after Chapter 4 warning promise; low-powered sparring teaches Kara technique.
Cat encourages measured help; Winn/James learn each other knows, assist smaller rescues; James cannot promise Cat will never recognize Kara.
Astra’s prisoner coercion changes when she sees public Kael footage: evacuation/surveillance, not unchanged kidnapping plan. Hellgrammite fears Kael explicitly.
Alex links fictional chlorine biology/DDT food; convoy includes closed approaches, Kara cargo protection and pre-unsealed Adrian.
Opening volley causes shallow graze/tire damage, but Adrian immediately stops the attacker. No Alex abduction.

Live video from captured operative’s phone replaces warehouse duel; current Astra survival/association confirmed, aircraft-order question unanswered. Hellgrammite captured alive; no physical Astra fight.
Training chosen within earlier lesson; interactive Alura introduced; reader-only Hank clue remains after Adrian reseals/leaves. No guaranteed AI answer yet.
Astra relocates/reassesses before ambush in response to Kael. No wound/knife means source kryptonite discovery cannot occur unchanged.
Kara chooses own interview and takes Cat’s car to nonspecific secluded location; full interview left to next episode.
